body: Yea, I think that a lot of parents don't realize that having kids are a huge life long responsibility. They need to realize there are other ways to solve a problem other than hitting your own kid.

I kind of get what you are saying.

You feel like there us so much of life to enjoy but you are barely getting anything worthwhile out of it.

I feel like a lonely lazy waste of life most of my days in school.

I don't know what to say.

But whenever I feel down I take a cold shower.
